builds.summary: Isolated Q multiplies (220+level bonus+1.2 AD[statFormula=2]+.7 AP) by 1.5. AP and magic penetration work despite its AD ratio; E passive penetration is included.
builds.goal: Isolated Q multiplies (220+level bonus+1.2 AD[statFormula=2]+.7 AP) by 1.5. AP and magic penetration work despite its AD ratio; E passive penetration is included.
builds.hypothesis:
Mordekaiser smashes the ground with Nightfall dealing [80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 7.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.7) × AP] magic damage, increased to [(80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 10, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 7.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.7) × AP) × (1.3 / 1.35 / 1.4 / 1.45 / 1.5)] if it hits only a single enemy.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

builds.name: Darkness Rise: four seconds of AP and health damage
builds.summary: Investigate high Darkness Rise field over four seconds output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high Darkness Rise field over four seconds output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The field source deals 5 + 0.3 AP plus a level-scaled 1%-5% enemy max HP per second. A fixed four-second window tests both AP and percentage-health damage. The separate 0.4 AP attack on-hit is not the field, and activating the field does not add three free setup hits to the scored output.
